For example, `includeCaptureDelayHours`: **true** means the standard notifications you get will contain the number of hours remaining until the payment will be captured.

* **TLSv1.2**
* **HTTP** - Only allowed on Test environment.

* **excludeAccounts**
* **allAccounts**: Includes all merchant accounts, and does not require specifying `filterMerchantAccounts`.

* **includeAccounts**
* **excludeAccounts**

Not needed for `filterMerchantAccountType`: **allAccounts**.

hasError.description: Indicates if the webhook configuration has errors that need troubleshooting. If the value is **true**, troubleshoot the configuration using the [testing endpoint](https://docs.adyen.com/api-explorer/#/ManagementService/v1/post/companies/{companyId}/webhooks/{webhookid}/test).

hasPassword.description: Indicates if the webhook is password protected.

hmacKeyCheckValue.description: The [checksum](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Key_checksum_value) of the HMAC key generated for this webhook. You can use this value to uniquely identify the HMAC key configured for this webhook.

processingType.description:
The type of transactions processed over this payment method.
 Allowed values:
- **pos** for in-person payments.

type.description:

serviceLevel.description:

* **gatewayContract**: American Express receives the settlement and handles disputes, then pays out to you or your sub-merchant directly.
* **paymentDesignatorContract**: Adyen receives the settlement, and handles disputes and payouts.

status.description:
The status of the merchant account.

Possible values:

* **PreActive**: The merchant account has been created. Users cannot access the merchant account in the Customer Area. The account cannot process payments.
* **Active**: Users can access the merchant account in the Customer Area. If the company account is also **Active**, then payment processing and payouts are enabled.
* **InactiveWithModifications**: Users can access the merchant account in the Customer Area. You cannot process new payments but you can still modify payments, for example issue refunds. You can still receive payouts.

* **Closed**: The account is closed and this cannot be reversed. Users cannot log in. Payment processing and payouts are disabled.
